text:
mira_pd: quick sync - new idea from field: "escrowed burst slabs" as an onboarding safety for reserved pools. want to capture discussion and next steps.
jon_k: explain escrowed slab? is it different from guaranteed slab or carryover?
mira_pd: shorter: when a customer signs reserved pool, we "escrow" a small slab of burst credits for first 30 days to reduce surprise throttles while they tune traffic. refundable if unused.
leah_p: field request: reduces churn during first-week spikes. Sales wants a straightforward SKU and clear signal in UI.
kevin_eng: runtime implications: escrow = ledger-held credits with state "escrowed". runtime prefers escrowed credits before using shared burst pool; reclaim rules needed.
olga_ops: ops concerns: need automated reclaim + announcement pipeline. also need synthetic tests for escrow exhaustion behavior.
sales-bot: note: finance needs refund flow + invoice labeling. refundable credits complicate month-end closes.
jon_k: proposal: pilot mode = escrowed slab of X tokens (configurable) for 30 days. two behaviors: auto-refund unused to customer account or convert to standard credits at end.
mira_pd: suggestion: default convert to standard credits unless customer opts for refund. simpler ops.
kevin_eng: sample config snippet:
```
escrow_policy:
  enabled: true
  slab_tokens: 1_000_000
  ttl_days: 30
  post_ttl: convert | refund
```
leah_p: launch criteria for pilot:
- 5 pilot customers onboarded
- zero billing disputes during pilot
- metrics: first-14d throttle_incidents drop >= 50% vs baseline
- ops: automated reclaim + email template ready
olga_ops: will add synthetic ramp tests and a console banner for escrow usage. will also log escrow_reclaim events.
sales-bot: pricing: include escrow slab as part of onboarding credit; zero charge unless convert-to-standard chosen. need agreement from finance.
jon_k: timeline: eng + ops can land pilot in 3 sprints if prioritized. smaller slab and longer TTL reduce complexity.
mira_pd: decision: greenlight pilot. owners: kevin=eng, olga=ops, leah=sales. mira will draft PRD and pilot outreach. will loop in finance/legal for refund flow.
kevin_eng: will open RFC for escrow ledger entries and edge-case reclaim rules. will post back with rough API surfaces.
leah_p: I'll identify 5 customers open to trial and prep comms. :thumbsup:
mira_pd: thanks team. we'll regroup after RFC and pilot signups."
